  WHERE title LIKE '%FDA%News%Release%'

FROM pks p
LEFT JOIN "drugbank_drug_syn" s
  ON s.drugbank_id = p.parent_key
 AND s.language LIKE '%english%'
GROUP BY p.parent_key
LIMIT 50;

WITH mab_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ds.drugbank_id AS parent_key
  FROM "drugbank_drug_syn" ds
  WHERE lower(ds.synonym) LIKE '%mab' OR lower(ds.synonym) LIKE '% monoclonal antibody%'
),
target_flags AS (
  SELECT t.parent_key,
         MAX(CASE WHEN lower(t.known_action) IN ('yes','binding','neutralizing','antagonist','agonist') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_action_annotation
  FROM "drugbank_targets" t
  GROUP BY t.parent_key
),
us_ped_patents AS (
  SELECT l.parent_key,
         l.title,
         CASE
           WHEN instr(lower(l.title), '20') > 0 THEN substr(l.title, instr(lower(l.title), '20'), 10)
           ELSE NULL
         END AS expiration_date_guess
  FROM "drugbank_drugs_links" l
  WHERE lower(l.title) LIKE '%patent%'
    AND lower(l.title) LIKE '%united states%'
    AND lower(l.title) LIKE '%pediatric%'
),
common_dates AS (
  SELECT parent_key, expiration_date_guess AS expiration_date, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM us_ped_patents
  WHERE expiration_date_guess IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY parent_key, expiration_date_guess
)
SELECT m.parent_key AS drugbank_id,
       CASE WHEN tf.has_action_annotation = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS antibody_based_mechanism_in_target_actions,
       cd.expiration_date,
       cd.cnt AS patents_sharing_this_date
FROM mab_drugs m
LEFT JOIN target_flags tf ON tf.parent_key = m.parent_key
LEFT JOIN common_dates cd ON cd.parent_key = m.parent_key
ORDER BY m.parent_key, cd.cnt DESC
LIMIT 50;
